annotation.title_clean: Article 62: Measures for providers and deployers, in particular SMEs, including start-ups
annotation.title_en: Article 62: Measures for providers and deployers, in particular SMEs, including start-ups
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, AI Act Service Desk
annotation.summary_en: Article 62 of the EU AI Act (consolidated text on the AI Act Service Desk, including Digital Omnibus amendments) sets out support measures for SMEs and start-ups: priority sandbox access, training, communication channels, reduced conformity assessment fees, and AI Office templates, a single information platform and awareness campaigns.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States give SMEs and start-ups priority access to AI regulatory sandboxes.
Member States organise tailored awareness and training activities and communication channels.
Conformity assessment fees are reduced proportionately for SME providers.
AI Office provides standardised templates and a single information platform.
AI Office runs awareness campaigns and promotes best practices in AI public procurement.
